V2L004.locus_context_note: Lead gene CELSR2 is a planar cell polarity receptor (Flamingo cadherin); the established causal gene at this locus is SORT1 (sortilin), a major hepatic regulator of LDL-C and PCSK9.

V2L061.locus_context_note: Lead gene DUSP13 is a MAPK phosphatase; the locus window also spans KCNMA1 (BKCa channel), a strong functional candidate in vascular smooth muscle.
